fixtures.name: Refinish Kit
fixtures.flavor: Brushes, lacquer and five finishes for the counter. Buy it once; repaint whenever the market is open, and the benches take the same colour.

fixtures.name: Cracked Plaster
fixtures.flavor: The wall the last tenant left. It holds, mostly, and the cracks have stopped growing.

fixtures.name: Fresh Plaster
fixtures.flavor: Skimmed flat and painted cream. The cracks are under it, and nobody has to know.

fixtures.name: Panelled Wall
fixtures.flavor: A coral wainscot along the whole wall and a stripe at the cornice. The room stops apologising.

fixtures.name: Chevron Wall
fixtures.flavor: Coral, cream and teal zigzags from corner to corner over the panelling. The room stops standing still.

fixtures.name: Harlequin Paper
fixtures.flavor: Pink and lilac diamonds over the panelling. The wall the postcards are of.

fixtures.name: Peeling Purple
fixtures.flavor: The last tenant's purple, peeling where the damp got in. The boards show through in three places, and nobody has asked about them.

fixtures.name: Plum Coat
fixtures.flavor: One coat of plum from the corner to the door. It hides the patches and nothing else.

fixtures.name: Bubble Paper
fixtures.flavor: Dark rounds on the purple and a run of stripes into the corner. It makes the door look like somebody meant it.

fixtures.name: Sunset Panelling
fixtures.flavor: Cream above a coral wainscot, a stripe at the cornice. The side wall finally matches the postcards.

fixtures.name: Flamingo Stripes
fixtures.flavor: Pink and cream bands running back to the door. The side wall finally looks like it belongs to a bar on the coast.

fixtures.name: Turquoise Diamonds
fixtures.flavor: Teal diamonds on cream, set square to the wall as it runs away from you. A pool you can lean on.

fixtures.name: Sunray Wall
fixtures.flavor: A sunset breaking out of the corner in coral and magenta rays. Nobody leaves by that door without looking at it.

fixtures.name: Beamed Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Dark beams across the plaster. The room gets a lid, and the lamps something to throw light at.

fixtures.name: Deco Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Stepped cream mouldings in long panels. It looks like the ceiling of somewhere that charges more.

fixtures.name: Palm Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Fronds painted overhead, as if the bar were under a tree. The smoke drifts through them.

fixtures.name: Stucco Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Hand-swirled plaster in warm white. Every lamp in the room looks softer under it.

fixtures.name: Rosette Panels
fixtures.flavor: Square coffers, each with a pink rosette at its heart. A ceiling you notice on your second drink.

fixtures.name: Sunray Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Coral and magenta rays from the middle of the room outward. The whole place leans towards the bar.

fixtures.name: Star Ceiling
fixtures.flavor: Night blue with gold stars pricked through it. Closing time outside, happy hour in here.

fixtures.name: City Triptych
fixtures.flavor: The skyline at night in three frames. The only view in the room that is not out of the window.

fixtures.name: Pop Trio
fixtures.flavor: A flamingo, two cherries and a pair of lips, one small frame each. Somebody always asks where they are from.

fixtures.name: Cocktail Trio
fixtures.flavor: A cocktail, a palm and a sun in gold frames. The house style, hung where everybody can read it.

fixtures.name: Vinyl Trio
fixtures.flavor: A record, a parrot and a wave, framed in teal and red. The loudest wall in the room without a speaker on it.

fixtures.name: Flamingo Triptych
fixtures.flavor: The coast in three frames. The flamingo stays past closing.

fixtures.name: Wall Television
fixtures.flavor: A boxy set bolted over the booths, running adverts nobody watches and everybody looks at.

fixtures.name: Malibu Poster
fixtures.flavor: A lifeguard hut under a burning sky, on a poster curling at one corner.

fixtures.name: Surf Poster
fixtures.flavor: A surfer on a teal wave, printed so big the grain shows. Nobody here has surfed.

fixtures.name: Pier Poster
fixtures.flavor: The pier at dusk with its lights coming on. The one postcard every tourist sends.

fixtures.name: Coast Poster
fixtures.flavor: The coast road from above, palms and sea and a thin white car. The drive everybody means to take.

fixtures.name: Neon Avenue Poster
fixtures.flavor: A street of pink and blue signs in the rain. It makes the room feel like part of a city.

fixtures.name: Convertible Poster
fixtures.flavor: A teal convertible parked facing the sunset, top down. The car the owner says he nearly bought.

fixtures.name: Diver Poster
fixtures.flavor: A diver in mid-air over a turquoise pool. The whole bar holds its breath with them.

fixtures.name: Pelican
fixtures.flavor: A pelican on a post in a dark wood frame. It watches the door so the bartender does not have to.

fixtures.name: Ocean Sunset
fixtures.flavor: Two palms, a pink sun and a turquoise sea, in a thin gold frame.

fixtures.name: Coast Road
fixtures.flavor: A white convertible on a road along the sea. Somebody painted it from memory.

fixtures.name: Memphis Shapes
fixtures.flavor: Triangles, circles and squiggles in the colours of the room. Nobody agrees what it is.

fixtures.name: Glass Tube Lamps
fixtures.flavor: Cyan at the cap, pink down the tube, a steel bracket holding it. The cheapest thing in the room that knows what year it is.

fixtures.name: Sunset Panels
fixtures.flavor: A cream face in a coral frame, wide as a window. It washes the wall instead of dotting it.

fixtures.name: Palm Lamps
fixtures.flavor: A brass palm with a lit coconut. Nobody needs it. Everybody wants it.

fixtures.name: Scallop Sconces
fixtures.flavor: Cream shades on brass arms, washing the wall in warm light. The kind of lamp a hotel bar has.

fixtures.name: Neon Tube Sconces
fixtures.flavor: A pink tube and a cyan tube side by side on each bracket. The wall hums, and so does the room.

fixtures.name: Shell Lamps
fixtures.flavor: Coral seashells glowing from inside. Everybody under them looks like they have been on holiday.

fixtures.name: Neon Martini
fixtures.flavor: The classic sign: a glass that never empties.

fixtures.name: Neon Flamingo
fixtures.flavor: A pink flamingo on one leg, buzzing faintly. It never gets tired of standing there.

fixtures.name: Neon Sunset
fixtures.flavor: A half sun sinking into pink lines. It sets every night at the same time the bar opens.

fixtures.name: Neon Glass
fixtures.flavor: A tall glass in cyan with pink inside and a cherry on the rim. The sign says what the bar is for.

fixtures.name: Neon Pelican
fixtures.flavor: A pelican in white and pink tube, beak full. The locals call the bar after it.

fixtures.name: Terracotta
fixtures.flavor: Warm clay tiles over the boards. It hides a spilled drink better than wood ever did.

fixtures.name: Carpet
fixtures.flavor: Plum carpet with a busy pattern, the kind that forgives everything. The room goes quiet underfoot.

fixtures.name: Marble Floor
fixtures.flavor: Cold white stone with grey veins. Heels sound expensive on it.

fixtures.name: Checker Floor
fixtures.flavor: Black and white squares running to the back wall. Every diner in every film had one.

fixtures.name: Neon Grid
fixtures.flavor: Dark tiles lined in pink and cyan, straight out of a video game. Walking to the bar feels like level one.

fixtures.name: Miami Terrazzo
fixtures.flavor: Chips of coral, teal and cream set in polished cream. A hotel lobby floor for a room that is not one.

fixtures.name: Wave Tiles
fixtures.flavor: Teal waves rolling across the whole floor. The tide came in and stayed for a drink.

fixtures.name: Tide Rug
fixtures.flavor: Orange running through teal, a shoreline read from the air. It takes the echo off the boards.

fixtures.name: Leopard Rug
fixtures.flavor: Spots from wall to wall, with a teal border to keep them in. Loud, and proud of it.

fixtures.name: Wave Rug
fixtures.flavor: A breaking wave woven across the boards. The tables look like they are standing on the shore.

fixtures.name: Memphis Rug
fixtures.flavor: Squiggles, dots and triangles in every colour the eighties sold. It argues with the walls and wins.

fixtures.name: Sunset Bands
fixtures.flavor: Stripes from gold to magenta to night, the evening laid flat on the floor.

fixtures.name: Palm Leaf Rug
fixtures.flavor: Big green fronds on cream. It makes the whole floor feel like somebody's verandah.

fixtures.name: Bistro Table
fixtures.flavor: A square top and two bentwood chairs that came with the lease. Nobody sits there long.

fixtures.name: Cocktail High-Top
fixtures.flavor: A tall round top on a brass stem, two red stools and a glass waiting on it. People stay for a second round.

fixtures.name: Teal Pedestal Set
fixtures.flavor: A teal top on a chrome pedestal, stools to match and the bottles already on it. The seat people ask for.

fixtures.name: Steel Gaslift Set
fixtures.flavor: Plum vinyl on a polished column. Spins if you let it.

fixtures.name: Steel Gaslift Set
fixtures.flavor: Plum vinyl on a polished column. Spins if you let it.

fixtures.name: Areca Palm
fixtures.flavor: Thin fronds and a clay pot. The cheapest way to stop a corner looking like a corridor.

fixtures.name: Yucca
fixtures.flavor: A spiky crown on a bare cane, in a terracotta pot. It stands guard by the window.

fixtures.name: Trailing Pothos
fixtures.flavor: It grows down instead of up, off three brass legs. The only plant in here that reaches for the floor.

fixtures.name: Agave Bowl
fixtures.flavor: Blue-green and low and wide, in a shallow dish. It sits under the neon rather than in front of it.

fixtures.name: Single Draught Tower
fixtures.flavor: One line, one lager. A start.

fixtures.name: Arched Draught Bridge
fixtures.flavor: A brass bridge on two legs, handles in a row across it.

fixtures.name: Triple Draught Tower
fixtures.flavor: One column, three spouts, and nothing waiting its turn.

fixtures.name: Steel Sink
fixtures.flavor: Cold water, a chipped drain, and a landlord who counts what goes down it.

fixtures.name: Brass Sink
fixtures.flavor: A basin that catches the neon and keeps it — and a drain nobody bills you for.

fixtures.name: Steel Shaker
fixtures.flavor: The tin the room came with. Dented at the base, cold in the hand, and it has never lost a drink.

fixtures.name: Gold Shaker
fixtures.flavor: Polished gold, and the drink inside it is exactly the same drink. That is not what anybody is looking at.

fixtures.name: Drip Mat
fixtures.flavor: Black rubber under the font. It catches what the glass does not.

fixtures.name: Snack Mat
fixtures.flavor: Cork under the dishes. It has never once been washed.
